name: circadia
description: Markdown-vault agent memory with a derived, brain-inspired graph index (hippocampal indexing, spreading activation, bi-temporal facts).

scripts.eval: node --experimental-strip-types --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning eval/generate-fixture.ts eval/.fixture && node --experimental-strip-types --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/cli/main.ts eval --fixture eval/.fixture
scripts.eval:check: node --experimental-strip-types --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning eval/generate-fixture.ts eval/.fixture && node --experimental-strip-types --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/cli/main.ts eval --fixture eval/.fixture --check
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "chore: release v%s" && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "chore: release v%s" && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "chore: release v%s" && git push && git push --tags
